title: Modern 90-Foot Tri-Deck Built for Extended Cruising
description: Modern 90-foot tri-deck motor yacht built for extended cruising, offering long-range fuel capacity, six-cabin luxury, advanced systems and superior comfort.
html:
A contemporary 90-foot tri-deck motor yacht from 2024 that pairs generous interior volume with systems and tankage suited for extended cruises, this vessel stands out for its three-deck arrangement, expansive glazing and a full suite of professional-grade mechanical and hospitality systems. With an approximate length of 90 ft (LOA 88.92 ft), a broad beam and 3,434 gallons of fuel capacity, it is set up to travel significant distances while offering multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces, robust power generation and advanced navigation and stabilization equipment that make both long passages and close-quarters handling straightforward.

Tri-deck 90ft motor yacht showcasing long-range luxury

The tri-deck configuration emphasizes range and habitability: a high-volume main deck salon and dining area, an enclosed upper sky lounge and a full flybridge provide layered living spaces that suit different climates and activities. The hull dimensions — roughly 90 ft with a 23.5 ft beam and a 6.08 ft draft — combine with a 3,434-gallon fuel tank, 400-gallon fresh water capacity and an HRO Seafari water maker (221 L/hr) to support extended cruising without frequent marina calls. Electrical and hotel systems include twin Kohler 32 kW generators, Victron 8 kW Quattro inverters, an isolation transformer and a fuel polishing system, all configured for reliable autonomy at anchor or underway.

Spacious tri-deck layout with six-cabin guest accommodations

The interior plan provides six cabins when including the dedicated crew quarters: four guest staterooms for owner and guests plus two crew cabins with a separate mess and laundry, delivering service separation and overnight crew capability. The owner’s stateroom is appointed with a king bed, a full en suite and large windows; a forward VIP has a queen berth and its own bathroom; two aft guest cabins (one queen, one twin) both feature en suites with upgraded stone shower finishes. Throughout the guest accommodation areas you’ll find high-end audiovisual packages, dimmable lighting controls and thoughtful storage, making multi-day living comfortable for owners and guests alike.

Twin MAN V12 engines and advanced propulsion systems details

Twin inboard MAN V12 1900 engines (1,900 hp each; total 3,800 hp) with approximately 590 engine hours drive a direct-drive propulsion system engineered for efficient cruising and reliable performance; detailed engine management is available via MAN MMDS interfaces. Manoeuvring systems include hydraulic Sleipner bow and stern thrusters with proportional joystick control, CMC fin stabilizers for underway and at-anchor comfort, and a comprehensive helm electronics suite featuring large Garmin multifunction displays, radar, autopilot and AIS. Supporting systems such as dual Kohler generators, a fuel polishing system and full power-management controls ensure the vessel is ready for extended passages and tight-port operations.

Interior luxury: entertainment packages and gourmet galley

The main salon presents oak wood flooring with inset carpeting, a modular club sofa, two armchairs and a dining table for eight positioned to take advantage of full-height side glazing; entertainment is handled by a Samsung 65″ QLED TV, Ultra HD Blu-ray and a Sonance/Sonos multi-zone audio system. The galley is a professional, owner-forward space with integrated Frigoboat refrigeration, additional drawer coolers, a Miele full-size dishwasher, wine cooler, Miele oven and microwave, plus an Elica Nikola Tesla Prime induction hob with extractor — a fit-out that supports full-service provisioning and chef-level meal preparation while underway.

Flybridge, aft deck and bathing platform outdoor amenities

Outdoor living is extensive: the enclosed flybridge saloon with a hard top and large TV creates an all-weather lounge and entertainer’s bar with Silestone quartz surfaces, refrigeration and Sonance audio; aft flybridge and cockpit areas include a stainless-steel BBQ, ice maker, electric awnings and natural teak decking for sunbathing or alfresco dining. The hydraulic bathing platform handles a tender up to 750 kg and is equipped with retractable cleats, a Besenzoni passerelle and freshwater deck wash; integrated safety rails, underwater Lumishore lighting and a forward sail canopy expand options for day use, water sports and guest comfort while at anchor.

Key features recap and leasing options — inquire within

The 2024 tri-deck motor yacht of about 90 ft offering a six-cabin layout (four guest, two crew), twin MAN V12 1900 engines (3,800 hp total), large fuel and water capacity, comprehensive electrical and hotel systems, CMC stabilizers and full Garmin navigation, luxurious interior AV and galley fitments, and extensive exterior entertaining and tender-handling gear — a platform configured for long-range cruising with comfortable liveaboard capability. Leasing options are available; please inquire to discuss availability, specifications and to arrange a visit or further materials.
